blog_summary: The blog post is a personal note from Adrian Colyer announcing a temporary pause of 'The Morning Paper' due to the COVID-19 pandemic and the closure of schools. He expresses concern for the safety of his family, friends, and neighbors, and shares his intention to prioritize helping others during this time. The post also mentions a potential shift to more sporadic or increased posting frequency in the future, depending on the circumstances. Additionally, it includes a brief section highlighting a few notable blog posts from the term so far.
